description: Put one claim of a project on other sites (PM-1165, PM-1166): a link anybody can open with no account, which shows its kind, number, title, statement with its formulas and status — never its bases, journal or review — and, while the project is public, the page it rests on. Answers with the ready code: 'script' once per page and 'mark' around the words on the site, which open the claim in a cloud, or 'iframe', a card. Name it by 'id', or by 'project' and 'label'. 'sites' and 'days' as for create_term_embed. Only for somebody who may write in the project; a line in its history.

days.description: Days the link answers, 1 to 3650. Optional: none is until it is removed.

id.description: The claim's id, as list_claims returned it. Or name it by 'project' and 'label'.

sites.description: Sites that may show it, comma-separated, as https://example.org. Optional: none is any site.

name: create_claim_embed
title: Create claim embed
